content.short: Quantstamp is a global leader in blockchain security, on a mission to secure the future of Web3.
content.description: Since 2017, Quantstamp has delivered security expertise through hundreds of audits for projects such as Ethereum 2.0, Solana, Binance Smart Chain, Visa, TON, Sandbox, Pendle, and Stacks. The firm has completed over 750 audits, helping protect more than $200 billion in digital assets from hackers. In addition to security services, Quantstamp supports the Web3 ecosystem with strategic investments and by serving as a trusted advisor to help projects scale.
content.meta: Quantstamp is a blockchain security firm focused on smart contract audits. Discover Quantstamp and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
